mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the risk-free rate and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 215.0 (indicating annual inflation above 3.5%) signals rising inflation expectations that lead to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 2.0% AND CPIAUCSL is above 215.0, the economy is in a stagflationary regime that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market contraction (HOUST below 1020 thousand units), the S&P 500 tends to have negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1020, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with a decrease in S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher unemployment signals economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is above 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (the 2017 base), it signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are below 1020 thousand units AND residential fixed investment (RSAFS) is below 370000 million dollars, the economy is in a demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1020 AND RSAFS < 370000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a stagflationary regime (CPIAUCSL > 215.0 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0), the S&P 500 tends to have negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to the dual pressures of high inflation and low interest rates.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 2.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
